# agent-workstation-admin

> agent-workstation-admin is a small toolkit, mostly POSIX shell, for administering one macOS
> workstation that runs many AI coding-agent sessions at once, such as Claude Code, Codex and
> Grok Build. It installs launchd jobs for health alerts, a machine-status file that agent
> sessions can read and act on, report-only daily and weekly checks, and log rotation, plus a
> session inventory and a configuration collector that scans for secrets before copying.

This file follows the llms.txt convention. It is an index for language models and agents
that read the repository from outside, such as a model asked to write code against it.
Links are absolute, so the file works when fetched on its own. They name `HEAD`,
which GitHub resolves to the default branch, whatever it is called.

## Start Here

- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/sgeos/agent-workstation-admin/blob/HEAD/CLAUDE.md): authoritative project context, conventions and per-session protocol.
- [README](https://github.com/sgeos/agent-workstation-admin/blob/HEAD/README.md): project overview and quick start.
